fact_text: North Nazimabad, a planned Karachi area set up under the KDA in 1956, covers about 23 sq km and is divided into roughly 19 blocks from A to U.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Property in North Nazimabad Still Worth It in 2025? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-13)

fact_text: North Nazimabad offers homes from about 120 sq yards up to 4,000 sq yards, plus apartments and high-rises, so it serves lower-middle, middle and upper-middle income buyers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Property in North Nazimabad Still Worth It in 2025? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-13)

fact_text: The association chairman said 12 to 13 projects were ongoing in North Nazimabad over the past two years, and 17 to 19 upcoming projects were due to start by Rabi ul Awwal.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Property in North Nazimabad Still Worth It in 2025? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-13)

fact_text: A category B builder in Block F, the area's most prime block, was taking bookings at about PKR 18,000 per sq ft, with a two-bedroom apartment priced under about PKR 20 million.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Property in North Nazimabad Still Worth It in 2025? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-13)

fact_text: In the upper category, a three-bedroom apartment in North Nazimabad was reported at close to PKR 30 million.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Property in North Nazimabad Still Worth It in 2025? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-13)

fact_text: A finished 200 sq yd house in good condition in North Nazimabad was said to cost at least PKR 3 crore, according to the interviewee.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Property in North Nazimabad Still Worth It in 2025? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-13)

fact_text: In H block, a house of about 200 sq yd due for demolition was said to be worth no less than PKR 4 crore, with the prime location as the main driver of value.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Property in North Nazimabad Still Worth It in 2025? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-13)

fact_text: A 10 to 15-year-old house in a lane of North Nazimabad was said to be available for about PKR 5.5 crore.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Property in North Nazimabad Still Worth It in 2025? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-13)

fact_text: The municipal authority declared some North Nazimabad residential plots commercial in 2007, which the interviewee said first lowered their values but later pushed them up sharply.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Property in North Nazimabad Still Worth It in 2025? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-13)

fact_text: The 1956 KDA plan put parks, mosques, libraries and commercial areas in every block, and the interviewee said these amenities remain in place.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Property in North Nazimabad Still Worth It in 2025? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-13)

fact_text: The interviewee said F and B blocks host many of Karachi's best-known schools, which makes the area attractive to families with children.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Property in North Nazimabad Still Worth It in 2025? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-13)

fact_text: Builders in North Nazimabad fall into three tiers: prime Karachi brands (A), mid-tier builders (B) and smaller builders (C), the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Property in North Nazimabad Still Worth It in 2025? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-13)

fact_text: The interviewee said the easy resale margin in North Nazimabad has gone, so a buyer may need to hold the property for 5 to 7 years before value rises.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Property in North Nazimabad Still Worth It in 2025? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-13)

fact_text: The interviewee said North Nazimabad prices did not fall even when prices across the rest of Karachi dropped in an earlier downturn.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Property in North Nazimabad Still Worth It in 2025? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-13)

fact_text: The interviewee said North Nazimabad is densely populated and that many residents, some of whom have lived there for generations, rarely move away.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Property in North Nazimabad Still Worth It in 2025? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-13)

fact_text: An interviewee said North Nazimabad ranks top in Karachi on literacy, with many educated, business-linked families, some in their third generation there.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Property in North Nazimabad Still Worth It in 2025? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-13)
